name: one-leg-45-degree-leg-press.html
instructions:
1. Load the machine with the desired weight and take a seat.
2. Sit down and position one foot directly in the middle of the sled.
3. Take a deep breath, extend your leg, and unlock the safeties.
4. Lower the weight under control until the leg is roughly 45 degrees or slightly below.
5. Drive the weight back to the starting position by extending the knee but don’t forcefully lockout.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
